Why this group exists

We care about efficient systems because constraints make ideas sharper.

NTS is for students who want to build beyond the obvious. That means compression, adaptation, evaluation, and actual engineering judgment, not just theory without consequence.

The first chapter centers on practical AI systems and a chatbot for future UTN students. Later, the group opens more room for multimodal work, world models, and member-led project lanes.

Build

Turn ideas into prototypes, tools, and experiments with a visible output.

Discuss

Use papers, critiques, and demos to improve what gets built next.

Stretch

Start practical, then push toward richer future-facing AI work.
